```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(data.table)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(pander)

quick_delta <- function(df, year_col, value_col, group_col) {
  df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_col]], .data[[year_col]]) %>%
    summarise(
      value = sum(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from   = .data[[year_col]],
      values_from = value,
      names_prefix = "Year_"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      delta = {
        yr_vals <- c_across(starts_with("Year_"))
        last(yr_vals) - first(yr_vals)
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-starts_with("Year_"))
}

rank_plus_delta <- function(df, year_col, metier_col, value_col, delta_tbl) {

  wide <- df |>
    group_by(.data[[year_col]], .data[[metier_col]]) |>
    summarise(
      total = sum(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = .data[[year_col]],
      values_from = total,
      names_prefix = "Year_"
    )

  # identify last year column robustly
  year_cols <- grep("^Year_", names(wide), value = TRUE)
  last_year <- year_cols[length(year_cols)]

  wide |>
    mutate(
      Rank = dense_rank(desc(.data[[last_year]]))
    ) |>
    left_join(delta_tbl, by = metier_col) |>
    arrange(Rank)
}

```

```{r}
# Reference lists 
## Scientific name 
urls <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ices-eg/RCGs/master/Metiers/Scripts/ICESVocabSpecies/ICESVocabAphiaIDScienName_2023.csv"
ScienName <- read.csv(urls, header = TRUE)

### Remove deprecated and invalid records 
ScienName <- filter(ScienName, !Deprecated %in% c("", "True", "2020-09-16")) %>%
  select(Code, Description) %>%
  mutate(Code = as.numeric(Code))
## Area - region (normal path gives back xml version)
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ices-eg/RCGs/master/Metiers/Reference_lists/AreaRegionLookup.csv"
Area <- read.csv(url, header = TRUE)
### Fix the extra space in rcg region code
Area <- mutate(Area, Code = ifelse(Code %in% "NSEA                                    " , "NSEA",
                             ifelse(Code %in% "NAtl                                      ", "NAtl", Code))) %>%
  select(AreaCode, Code)

# ---------------------------
# Confidentiality parameters
# ---------------------------

apply_confidentiality <- function(raw_data,
                                  agg_data,
                                  group_vars,      # character vector
                                  value_vars,      # character vector
                                  vessel_id,
                                  vessel_limit = 3) {

  # 1. Count vessels from RAW data
  vessel_counts <- raw_data |>
    tidyr::separate_rows({{ vessel_id }}, sep = "\\s*;\\s*|\\s*/\\s*") |>
    dplyr::group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_vessels = n_distinct({{ vessel_id }}),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # 2. Join vessel counts onto AGGREGATED data
  agg_conf <- agg_data |>
    left_join(vessel_counts, by = group_vars) |>
    mutate(n_vessels = tidyr::replace_na(n_vessels, 0L))

  # 3. Totals before
  totals_before <- agg_conf |>
    summarise(across(all_of(value_vars),
                     ~ sum(as.numeric(.x), na.rm = TRUE)))

  # 4. Apply confidentiality rule
  agg_after <- agg_conf |>
    filter(n_vessels >= vessel_limit)

  # 5. Totals after
  totals_after <- agg_after |>
    summarise(across(all_of(value_vars),
                     ~ sum(as.numeric(.x), na.rm = TRUE)))

  # 6. % removed
  removed_pct <- tibble::tibble(
    Metric = value_vars,
    Percent_removed =
      round(
        100 * (as.numeric(totals_before) - as.numeric(totals_after)) /
          as.numeric(totals_before),
        1
      )
  ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = Metric,
      values_from = Percent_removed
    )

  list(
    data_filtered = agg_after |> select(-n_vessels),
    removed_table = removed_pct
  )
}

print_removed_table <- function(x, caption) {

  html <- paste0(
    "<p><strong>", caption, "</strong></p>",
    knitr::kable(
      x,
      format = "html",
      digits = 1
    ) |>
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        full_width = FALSE,
        position = "left"
      )
  )

  cat(html)
}

```

```{r}
# Process
## Year string 
CL$CLyear <- as.character(CL$CLyear)
CE$CEyear <- as.character(CE$CEyear)

## Month factors 
CL$CLmonth <- factor(CL$CLmonth, levels = as.character(c(1:12)))
CE$CEmonth <- factor(CE$CEmonth, levels = as.character(c(1:12)))

## Quarter factors 
CL$CLquarter <- factor(CL$CLquarter, levels = as.character(c(1:4)))
CE$CEquarter <- factor(CE$CEquarter, levels = as.character(c(1:4)))

## Vessel length factors 
CL$CLvesLenCat <- factor(CL$CLvesselLengthCategory, levels = c("VL0006","VL0608", "VL0810", "VL1012", "VL1215", "VL1518", "VL1824", "VL2440", "VL40XX", "NK"))
CE$CEvesLenCat <- factor(CE$CEvesselLengthCategory, levels = c("VL0006","VL0608", "VL0810", "VL1012", "VL1215", "VL1518", "VL1824", "VL2440", "VL40XX", "NK"))

## Country factors 
CL$CLvesselFlagCountry <- factor(CL$CLvesselFlagCountry, levels = sort(unique(CL$CLvesselFlagCountry)))
CE$CEvesselFlagCountry <- factor(CE$CEvesselFlagCountry, levels = sort(unique(CE$CEvesselFlagCountry)))

## Get metier lvl 4 
CL <- mutate(CL, CLmetier4 = str_extract(CLmetier6, "[^_]+"))
CE <- mutate(CE, CEmetier4 = str_extract(CEmetier6, "[^_]+"))

## Get metier lvl 5 
CL <- mutate(CL, CLmetier5 = str_extract(CLmetier6,  "[^_]*_[^_]*"))
CE <- mutate(CE, CEmetier5 = str_extract(CEmetier6,  "[^_]*_[^_]*"))


# Weight kg to t 
CL <- mutate(CL, CLscientificWeight = round(CLscientificWeight/1000, digits = 2))

# Filter CatchCategory == Landings
CL <- filter(CL, CLcatchCategory %in% "Lan")

CL <- CL |>
  mutate(
    CLlandingsValue = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(CLlandingsValue))
  )

```

```{r top10-driver, results='asis', echo=FALSE}

driver_tbl <- "effort"     # "effort" | "weight"
driver_n   <- 10

## ------------------------------------------------------------------

if (driver_tbl == "effort") {

  drv_tbl      <- CE_3yr_raw
  drv_col      <- "scientificDaysAtSea"
  driver_label <- "scientific fishing days"

  met4 <- "CEmetier4"
  met5 <- "CEmetier5"
  met6 <- "CEmetier6"

} else {

  drv_tbl      <- CL_3yr_raw
  drv_col      <- "scientificWeight"
  driver_label <- "scientific landed weight"

  met4 <- "CLmetier4"
  met5 <- "CLmetier5"
  met6 <- "CLmetier6"
}

## helper ----------------------------------------------------------------------
get_topN <- function(tbl, met, val, n = driver_n) {
  tbl |>
    group_by(.data[[met]]) |>
    summarise(total = sum(.data[[val]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    slice_max(total, n = n) |>
    pull(.data[[met]])
}


## compute the three driver lists ---------------------------------------------
top10_L4 <- get_topN(drv_tbl, met4, drv_col)
top10_L5 <- get_topN(drv_tbl, met5, drv_col)
top10_L6 <- get_topN(drv_tbl, met6, drv_col)

## FILTER the yearly & 3-year tables *once*  -----------------------------------
CL_byYear_L4 <- CL_byYear_conf |> filter(CLmetier4 %in% top10_L4)
CL_byYear_L5 <- CL_byYear_conf |> filter(CLmetier5 %in% top10_L5)
CL_byYear_L6 <- CL_byYear_conf |> filter(CLmetier6 %in% top10_L6)

CE_byYear_L4 <- CE_byYear_conf |> filter(CEmetier4 %in% top10_L4)
CE_byYear_L5 <- CE_byYear_conf |> filter(CEmetier5 %in% top10_L5)
CE_byYear_L6 <- CE_byYear_conf |> filter(CEmetier6 %in% top10_L6)

```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}

pandoc.header("Executive Summary", level = 1)

pandoc.p(glue::glue("
This report provides an overview of fishing activity in **{rrr}** over {paste(multi_years, collapse = '–')}, 
drawing on **Commercial Landings** (CL) and **Commercial Effort** (CE) data submitted to the RDBES in 2025.  
We consider only **landings** (catch category `'Lan'`) and express landings in scientific weight (t) and value (€), 
and effort as scientific fishing days and number of trips, broken down by flag-state and vessel size class.

To characterise dominant metiers at each level, we apply a Top-10 rule, independently at each tier:

- **Level 4:** the ten L4 gears with the highest cumulative {driver_label}.  
- **Level 5:** the ten L5 variants with the highest cumulative {driver_label}.  
- **Level 6:** the ten L6 mesh-sizes with the highest cumulative {driver_label}.  

Subsequent sections visualise whole-fleet annual and quarterly trends, followed by metier-level time series and rankings for the Top 10 at Levels 4–6.

**Update in 2026: All tables and graphs have been filtered so that it only shows data where there are at least 3 vessels. In connection to plots and tables, a supplementary table indicates the percentage of data removed due to appliation of confidentiality rules.**
"))

```

```{r, results='asis',  echo=FALSE}

pandoc.header("Trends top 10 métier level 4", level = 1)
pandoc.p(glue::glue(
  "Over {paste(multi_years, collapse = '–')}, we ranked the Top-{driver_n} Level‑4 gears ",
  "by cumulative {driver_label}. The four panels below show annual trends in landed weight, ",
  "landed value, fishing days and number of trips for these métiers."
))

pandoc.header("Annual variation top 10 métier level 4", level = 2)

# ---- Guard: no data after confidentiality -----------------------------------
if (nrow(CL_year_topL4) == 0 && nrow(CE_year_topL4) == 0) {

  pandoc.p(
    "After applying confidentiality rules (n < 3 vessels), no Level‑4 métiers remain for the selected years."
  )

} else {

  # ---- Plots ---------------------------------------------------------------

  p1 <- ggplot(CL_year_topL4,
               aes(reorder(CLmetier4, -TotWeight), TotWeight, fill = CLyear)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "Métier L4", y = "Weight (t)", title = "Landed weight") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  p2 <- ggplot(CL_year_topL4,
               aes(reorder(CLmetier4, -TotValue), TotValue, fill = CLyear)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "Métier L4", y = "Value (€)", title = "Landed value (€)") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  p3 <- ggplot(CE_year_topL4,
               aes(reorder(CEmetier4, -TotDays), TotDays, fill = CEyear)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "Métier L4", y = "Days at sea", title = "Fishing days") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  p4 <- ggplot(CE_year_topL4,
               aes(reorder(CEmetier4, -TotTrips), TotTrips, fill = CEyear)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "Métier L4", y = "Trips", title = "Number of trips") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  print(ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2, nrow = 2))

  # ---- Confidentiality reporting (ONE wide table) --------------------------

  conf_L4_annual_wide <- dplyr::bind_cols(
    conf_CL_year_topL4$removed_table,
    conf_CE_year_topL4$removed_table
  )

  print_removed_table(
    conf_L4_annual_wide,
    "Percentage of data removed due to confidentiality rules (Level‑4 annual trends)."
  )
}
```
